principle: Exact visual parity, accessible behavioral parity and identical accessibility-tree implementation are different acceptance dimensions. Do not destroy working native behavior merely to make role strings look identical in a static AX snapshot.

review_inactive_tab_names.fresh_delta: Reference inactive tabs expose company-only names while target inactive tabs currently include company + person/title; selected Panasonic includes person/title on both.
review_inactive_tab_names.risk: The source name may change dynamically with selection because hidden/visible metadata contributes to accessible naming. Current Opera connector cannot activate tabs or observe the post-selection source name transition.
future_gate: With an interaction-capable browser, record all three reference tab accessible names in each selected state.
Repeat on target without changing code.
Only if a stable dynamic naming contract differs, modify the single existing page264 semantic owner; never add a second handler/owner.
Re-test Arrow/Home/End, prev/next, panel focus and v012 visual-dot pointer containment before release.

faq_control_roles.fresh_delta: Reference exposes question buttons with aria-controls; target exposes native details/summary disclosureTriangle controls.
faq_control_roles.known_behavior_contract: Direct live source script toggles only the activated item and allows independent multi-open. Target native details/summary implements the same multi-open design without duplicate JS.
faq_control_roles.reason: A static role-label implementation difference is not evidence of visual or behavioral failure. Rebuilding native details into scripted buttons would increase regression risk and duplicate ownership without a proven user-facing defect.
faq_control_roles.future_gate: Only reopen if pointer/keyboard/focus behavior itself fails against source in an interaction-capable synchronized test.

story_dt_casing.fresh_delta: Reference AX text uses KIINDULÓ HELYZET / DÖNTÉS / EREDMÉNY; target AX text is title case.
story_dt_casing.visual_uncertainty: The target may already use CSS text-transform for the visible uppercase treatment; AX casing alone cannot prove a visible mismatch.
future_gate: Obtain synchronized visual/computed-style evidence for dt text-transform and rendered casing.
If visuals already match, preserve stored target copy.
If visuals differ, prefer a page264-local visual style owner rather than changing semantic text solely to imitate uppercase rendering.

global_header_footer.rule: Record for future explicit global handoff only. Do not compensate inside page264 body content or local CSS/JS.

moving_carousel_state.rule: Nordmann 5/6 target versus 2/6 reference is not a defect unless captured at synchronized timing/state.
